options.description: ctx.args as JSON, or @path to read it from a file

options.description: Repository for tasks whose spec names none (default: the configured repo)

options.name: --workflow-default
options.description: Workflow for tasks whose spec names none

options.name: --run-id
options.description: Run id (a GUID); a new one by default. Child tasks carry it as OriginRunId

options.name: --from-run
options.description: Reuse the results of an ended run (see --start-at, --redo, --redo-failed)

options.name: --start-at
options.description: With --from-run: redo this command and everything after it in script order

options.name: --redo
options.description:
With --from-run: redo these commands (comma list; c3 includes the calls in
c3's branches)

options.name: --redo-failed
options.description:
With --from-run: redo tasks that did not end Completed, refused commands and
cancelled ones

options.name: --poll-wait
options.description: Longest wait between wakes (default 60; task events wake the run sooner)

options.name: --json
options.description:
Progress on stderr; stdout is one summary object (runId, status, output,
error)
